convert_model: convert a pytorch model's linear and layernorm layers to transformer_engine equivalents recursively
has_transformer_engine_layers: check whether a given pytorch model contains any transformer_engine layers
contextual_fp8_autocast: wrap a model's forward method with fp8 autocast that respects training and eval mode
apply_fp8_autowrap: apply fp8 autocast context manager to a model's forward method using an fp8 recipe handler
convert_model_reverse: convert a model's transformer_engine linear and layernorm layers back to standard pytorch nn.Linear and nn.LayerNorm
